Quit vaping with nicotine-free streak tracking, craving tools, and health milestones

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Quit Vaping skill.

- Track your nicotine-free streak with real-time updates based on your quit date.
- Access tools to manage cravings: breathing exercises, delay tactics, and urge logging.
- Visualize health recovery milestones, showing key benefits at 20 minutes, 24 hours, 1 week, 1 month, and 3 months smoke-free.
- Monitor your progress with a dashboard featuring days quit, money saved, and improved health markers.
- All data remains private and local on your device.
